bumrah_economy_by_lighting.sql: SELECT daynight, SUM(CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER)), SUM(CASE WHEN wide = '0' AND noball = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(6.0 * SUM(CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER)) / SUM(CASE WHEN wide = '0' AND noball = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE bowl = 'Jasprit Bumrah' GROUP BY daynight ORDER BY daynight

bumrah_overs_41_to_50_economy.sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER)), SUM(CASE WHEN wide = '0' AND noball = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(6.0 * SUM(CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER)) / SUM(CASE WHEN wide = '0' AND noball = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE bowl = 'Jasprit Bumrah' AND CAST(over AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 41 AND 50

kohli_caught_bowled.sql: SELECT dismissal, COUNT(*) FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE out = 'True' AND dismissal IN ('caught', 'bowled') AND p_out IN (SELECT DISTINCT p_bat FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE bat = 'Virat Kohli') GROUP BY dismissal ORDER BY dismissal

kohli_sixes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE bat = 'Virat Kohli' AND batruns = '6'

lowest_team_economy_against_india.sql: SELECT team_bowl, SUM(CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER)) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wide = '0' AND noball = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal, ROUND(6.0 * SUM(CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER)) / SUM(CASE WHEN wide = '0' AND noball = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS economy FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE team_bat = 'India' GROUP BY team_bowl HAVING legal >= 600 ORDER BY economy, team_bowl LIMIT 1

rohit_required_rate_above_8.sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(batruns AS INTEGER)), SUM(CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER)), ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(batruns AS INTEGER)) / SUM(CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER)), 2) FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE bat = 'Rohit Sharma' AND TRY_CAST(inns_rrr AS DOUBLE) > 8

stored_over_is_one_based.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(over AS INTEGER) = CAST(CEIL(CAST(inns_balls AS INTEGER) / 6.0) AS INTEGER) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE wide = '0' AND noball = '0' AND CAST(inns_balls AS INTEGER) > 0

successful_chase_top_run_scorer.sql: SELECT bat, SUM(CAST(batruns AS INTEGER)) AS runs FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE inns = '2' AND winner = team_bat GROUP BY bat ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 1

world_cup_2019_final_toss.sql: WITH wc AS (SELECT * FROM analytics.deliveries_v1 WHERE competition = 'ICC Cricket World Cup' AND year = '2019'), final AS (SELECT DISTINCT p_match FROM wc WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM wc)) SELECT DISTINCT toss, winner FROM wc WHERE p_match IN (SELECT p_match FROM final)
